announcements.title: Official Launch of Vigilans Workplace Platform
announcements.content: We are thrilled to roll out Vigilans across all departments. You can now track attendance via the office barcode, manage your sprint tasks, record voice notes in team chat, and join video meetings directly inside the platform.

announcements.title: Standard Work Hours & Lateness Policy
announcements.content: Core office hours begin promptly at 9:00 AM. Automatic clock-out takes effect at 5:00 PM. Please remember to clock in using your camera barcode scanner when arriving.
